'''Varek Tarn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warlord during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He stole the construction plans for the [[Sovereign Forge]], a planned Imperial mining station and shipyard, and attempted to sell them to the Republic at a minefield in the [[Cha Raaba system]], escorted by his own ships. However, the Empire caught up to Tarn and [[Battle in the Cha Raaba system|destroyed]] the shuttle carrying the plans.<ref name="TOR:CRA" />
